4. Enter the quantities per location. Enter the received date and place; these fields apply to all rows.
5. Click **Save Updates**, then **Confirm & Save**.

Both bulk-update pages require the **PMS admin permission on the server**; the manual itself does not specify a role. The Office and Vessel excerpts describe the same Stores procedure, with no stated Office/Ship difference.

Source: Consume and Receive — *Technical - PMS User Manual_Vessel Specific_R3_08.07.2026*, §1.1.8.3, p.43; *Technical - PMS User Manual For Office_Sail Admin_R2_08.06.2026*, §1.1.8.3, p.50; resolved cross-reference to the Spares procedure.

results.response:
No. Stores uses the same bulk-update procedure as Spares after you enter the Stores screen, but you must remain in Stores; do not open the Spares sub-sub-module.

The Stores bulk-update process is:

1. Open the **Stores** sub-sub-module. This applies to the selected category—**Stores, Lubes, Chemicals, or Others**—and the selected tab, such as **Inventory, Location, or History**.
2. Click **+ Bulk Updates Store** / **Bulk Update Stores**.
3. On the Stores bulk-update page, select **Consume** or **Receive**.
4. Enter the quantities for each location. For **Receive**, enter the received date and place; these fields apply to all rows.
5. Click **Save Updates**.
6. Click **Confirm & Save**.

The bulk-update page requires the **PMS admin permission on the server**; the manuals do not specify a user role. Stores and Spares have separate bulk-update pages.

The cross-reference is resolved in the manuals: the remaining Stores steps are the same as the Spares bulk-update procedure—**section 1.1.7.6, page 40** in the Vessel manual, and **section 1.1.7.8, page 47** in the Office manual.

**Source:**  
- Vessel Technical PMS User Manual, §1.1.8.3, p.43; resolved cross-reference to §1.1.7.6, p.40.  
- Office Sail Admin Technical PMS User Manual, §1.1.8.3, p.50; resolved cross-reference to §1.1.7.8, p.47.
